import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json
def p(x,y): return adsk.core.Point3D.create(x,y,0)
def rectangle(sk,x0,y0,x1,y1):
    ls=sk.sketchCurves.sketchLines
    ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x0,y0),p(x1,y0))
    ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x1,y0),p(x1,y1))
    ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x1,y1),p(x0,y1))
    ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x0,y1),p(x0,y0))
def extrude(root,sk,dist,op,name):
    ex=root.features.extrudeFeatures
    feat=ex.addSimple(sk.profiles.item(0),adsk.core.ValueInput.createByReal(dist),op)
    feat.name=name
    return feat
def run(_context):
    app=adsk.core.Application.get()
    des=adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeProduct)
    root=des.rootComponent
    ref=root.sketches.item(0)
    bb=ref.boundingBox
    x0=bb.minPoint.x-0.40; x1=bb.maxPoint.x+0.40; y0=bb.minPoint.y-0.40; y1=bb.maxPoint.y+0.40
    ix0=bb.minPoint.x-0.10; ix1=bb.maxPoint.x+0.10; iy0=bb.minPoint.y-0.10; iy1=bb.maxPoint.y+0.10
    s= root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); s.name='LEFT_CASE_OUTER_PROFILE'; rectangle(s,x0,y0,x1,y1)
    body=extrude(root,s,0.80,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.NewBodyFeatureOperation,'LEFT_CASE_WALL_BLANK')
    s2=root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); s2.name='LEFT_CASE_CAVITY_PROFILE'; rectangle(s2,ix0,iy0,ix1,iy1)
    cut=extrude(root,s2,0.80,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.CutFeatureOperation,'LEFT_CASE_CAVITY')
    s3=root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); s3.name='LEFT_CASE_FLOOR_PROFILE'; rectangle(s3,x0,y0,x1,y1)
    floor=extrude(root,s3,0.25,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.JoinFeatureOperation,'LEFT_CASE_FLOOR')
    s.isVisible=False; s2.isVisible=False; s3.isVisible=False; ref.isVisible=False
    print(json.dumps({'case':'left','bounds_cm':[x0,y0,x1,y1],'cavity_cm':[ix0,iy0,ix1,iy1],'wall_height_cm':0.8,'floor_cm':0.25,'bodies':[b.name for b in root.bRepBodies]}))
